name: qa_usbdisk_chord_all4
title: OS-USBDISK U1d, QA-GLB-016: power on holding Shift + F1 + F7 + F8: no disk mode

steps.say: OS-USBDISK U1d, row QA-GLB-016, case all4: hold Shift + F1 + F7 + F8 while powering the unit on, then start this run. Nothing is injected, nothing is written

steps.note: the chord was read and is not the disk chord
a normal boot: the Tracker owns the card (a card in the slot is mounted)
Shift + F1 + F7 + F8 is INPUT TEST (soft: the screen name)
